_comment: Base (non-reconciling) residential tariff, maintained by hand from the NEPR rate-case order and LUMA's tariff book. Factors that change quarterly/annually come from LUMA's Tabla de Factores and are NOT stored here.
rate_class_name: General Residential Service (Servicio Residencial General), non-subsidized

sources.name: NEPR Final Resolution and Order on Electricity Rates, NEPR-AP-2023-0003 (2026-04-15), Appendix B (PDF p. 773): GRS $8.00/month + $0.08648/kWh (both 425 kWh blocks equal)
LUMA FY2027 Tariff Book, approved by NEPR 2026-07-22 (NEPR-MI-2026-0005); Pension and Provisional riders folded into base rates
NEPR Resolution and Order 2026-09-30 (Table 2: GRS 800 kWh bill $270.86 = $0.33858/kWh, which these base values reproduce)

base_tariffs.note: FY2028 rates as ordered on 2026-04-15; re-verify against the FY2028 tariff book before July 2027.

sources.name: NEPR Final Resolution and Order on Electricity Rates, NEPR-AP-2023-0003 (2026-04-15), Appendix B: FY2028 GRS $16.00/month + $0.06275/kWh

excluded_components.FOS: Fuel subsidy credit (Cláusula de Subsidio de Combustible) for qualifying subsidized customers using under 500 kWh/month; it is a credit, not a charge to the standard residential customer, so it is published separately and never added to the price.

history_note: Prices before 2026-07-01 are not published: the pre-rate-case split between customer and energy charge has not been verified from a primary source, so those quarters carry factors only.
